label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for a civic appreciation presentation or reception for me in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00–18:30, with contents deliberately kept private. I was told about and approved the presentation, but not its contents or full arrangements. Innkeeper is the confirmed organiser; baker and builder arranged a private forty-four-loaf order paid for in materials, plausibly connected, and freight was seen carrying bread toward the hall and reported in bakery discussions. Their exact connection to the presentation is inferred rather than confirmed. Secretary knowingly helps by scheduling, arranging precise arrival and escort, and explicitly keeping contents private. Neighbour's knowing involvement is not established; presence in reported discussions and usual tea are insufficient. Vague bridge/port rumours do not establish a separate infrastructure project.
